rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a familiar folk-style proverb in everyday Cantonese.

example.english: The proverb says, “If you can eat salted fish, you can handle thirst.”
example.traditional: 俗語話，食得鹹魚抵得渴。
example.jyutping: zuk6 jyu5 waa6 sik6 dak1 haam4 jyu4 dai2 dak1 hot3

rows.note: Use this more precise term when discussing proverbs as a category, especially in explanatory or educational contexts.

example.english: This proverb is often discussed in Chinese class.
example.traditional: 呢句諺語喺中文課成日都會講到。
example.jyutping: ni1 geoi3 jin6 jyu5 hai2 zung1 man4 fo3 seng4 jat6 dou1 wui5 gong2 dou3

rows.note: Use this for a moral or admonitory maxim rather than an ordinary folk proverb.

example.english: This proverb reminds people to stay humble.
example.traditional: 呢句箴言提醒人哋，做人要謙虛。
example.jyutping: ni1 geoi3 zam1 jin4 tai4 seng2 jan4 dei6 zou6 jan4 jiu3 him1 heoi1
